title: iTestAgent Artifact Index
description: Published JSON Schema for the iTestAgent artifact index file (artifact-index.json). Runtime source of truth: ArtifactIndexSchema in packages/itestagent-contracts/src/artifact-index-contract.ts (Architecture Design §6.6; AGENTS.md §5 data contracts). Parity is enforced by packages/itestagent-contracts/test/json-schema-parity.test.ts (B03). Unknown keys are stripped at runtime, so additional properties are not forbidden here.

schemaVersion.description: Artifact-index schema version (AGENTS.md §5: artifacts carry schemaVersion).

runId.description: Run this index belongs to. Must equal the runId of the paired result.json.

artifacts.description: Metadata for every artifact collected during the run. Artifact ids must be unique within one index (enforced by json-schema-cross-field.ts).

id.description: Stable artifact identifier, referenced by result.json artifactRefs[].

path.description: Path relative to the run directory.

sha256.description: SHA-256 checksum of the file contents.

relatedStep.description: Run step ID that produced this artifact.

redactionStatus.description: R6 redaction state: raw-local-only stays on the local machine only; redacted has sensitive content scrubbed; safe contains no sensitive content.
